Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1344
Claimant:
Karen Melendez
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
February 12, 2024
Claim opened for a parking lot collision in which the insured's vehicle was struck while stopped. The claimant reports
a knee injury and is represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the attorney's office.
February 22, 2024
Confirmed the drvier is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
April 11, 2024
Police report and two statements confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. No independent
witnesses have come forward to describe the collision itself.
May 6, 2024
Reviewed scene photos. They confirm the general location and point of contact, though the lot camera did not
capture the moment of impact.
May 22, 2024
Reviewed the photos of the vehicles. A few old scratches appear on the rear bumper and may be older than this
crash, so the repair estimate is being checked against them.
June 21, 2024
The claimant's first statement was given to the attorney's office. Later the claimant added smaller details about seat
position and the seconds before impact, but the core account has not changed.
July 4, 2024
Medical records show a knee injury that is plausible for a low-speed impact of this kind. No prior injury to the same
area appears in the records we have requested.
July 22, 2024
Treatment followed a typical course of therapy and tapered off as the claimant improved. The most recent records
describe a steady recovery.
September 8, 2024
The medical provider and the damage estimate do not yet fully line up. It is unclear whether all of the vehicle damage
and the injury came from this single impact, so the question has been sent to the appraiser and the treating provider.
September 13, 2024
Reserve reviewed and kept in place pending the appraiser's supplemental findings and the attorney's response to our
request for records. Next review is scheduled once thsoe are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
